venue.name: Emily Carr House
venue.description: Carr House is a national historic site in Victoria associated with the painter Emily Carr, where visitors book a guided tour to learn about Carr and her legacy. The site says it offers a range of educational programs for school groups, from guided tours to scavenger hunts, as well as art classes, upcoming events and venue rentals. Every page of carrhouse.org renders its content in JavaScript, so on this run only the information published in each page's metadata could be read - no address, prices, ages, hours or booking details could be confirmed.
